wrong_setting: The crowd and station design read as East Asian rather than Addis Ababa, and the signage looks generic or Chinese-style; nothing identifies the scene as Ethiopian.
notes: Make the setting clearly Addis Ababa: make the crowd and both leads Ethiopian with skin tones matching the reference sheet, arrange the people into one long winding queue ending at a single small ticket window, remove all lettering from the signs, and push the rendering toward soft gouache brushwork.
